header: Automating snapshots with Index State Management
content:
You can use the Index State Management (ISM) snapshot operation to automatically trigger
snapshots of indexes based on changes in their age, size, or number of documents. ISM is best
when you need one snapshot per index. If you need to snapshot of a group of indices, see
Automating snapshots with Snapshot Management.
To use SM in OpenSearch Service, you need to register your own Amazon S3 repository. For an
example ISM policy using the snapshot operation, see Sample Policies.
